title: A Jumbo Jet Ran Out Of Fuel. The Pilot Glided It Onto A Racetrack ✈️
caption:
A passenger jet ran out of fuel in mid air ✈️
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In 1983 Air Canada Flight 143 ran out of fuel after fuel was calculated in pounds instead of kilograms. The pilot, an experienced glider pilot, glided the Boeing 767 to a landing at Gimli, on a former air base turned racetrack. Nobody died.
Would you have stayed calm? 👇
first_comment: Fun fact: he was also an experienced glider pilot. Best coincidence in aviation history? ✈️👇
